sources.label: Google Voice
sources.author: Google Voice
patch_list: Automatically records every incoming and outgoing Voice call (both sides) to Recordings/Voice calls. Works for calls made over Wi-Fi or mobile data, not calls Voice routes through the carrier.
Saves the app's own log to Downloads/voice-logcat-<time>.txt each time the app starts, including every push message it receives. For troubleshooting only.
Lets Google Voice be chosen as the default phone app (Settings > Apps > Default apps > Phone app). Tapping a phone number then opens Voice, and carrier calls get a basic in-call screen.

Lets Voice sign in and get calls/texts without root by using MicroG RE (install it from Morphe Manager) instead of Google Play Services. Also gives the app its own package name, so it installs next to the original.

Makes incoming calls ring with MicroG. MicroG can't wake the app for calls like Google Play Services does, so the app briefly shows an invisible overlay when a call comes in. Needs "Appear on top", which the app asks for once.
